title: Avoiding Microservice Megadisasters - Jimmy Bogard
summary: Jimmy Bogard presents a post-mortem of a real microservices migration that turned into a slow distributed monolith. He covers the modeling, development and production problems and how the team recovered.
why: Recommended as an entertaining cautionary talk on microservice failures and Conway's law.

quote.text: Inverse Conway Maneuver: Design the organization you want, the architecture will follow, kicking and screaming.
